method: Read current public official pages for the specific purchasing-route and customs claims revised in the buying guides. Earlier owner accounts retain their separate 2026-09-22 research basis. A listed route is not an inventory check or an order-specific quote.

sources.finding: Lists named dealers in North America and multiple European countries.
sources.limits: Does not establish stock, a particular T1550 generation, or support terms for an unquoted order.

sources.finding: Describes EU complete-bike shipping from within the EU and US assembly and shipping in the US.
sources.limits: Does not cover Canada or verify exact size and finish inventory.

sources.finding: Directs buyers toward brand or country distributors and describes a general six-to-ten-week manufacturing-and-delivery estimate for frames and complete bikes.
sources.limits: Not an order-specific production or delivery commitment.

sources.finding: Lists destination-specific shipping methods and prepaid-tax service regions.
sources.limits: Terms depend on route and destination; compare the actual checkout with the separate regional shipping policy.

sources.finding: Points European customers toward a German-warehouse regional site.
sources.limits: Does not establish stock of a particular model or supersede a written order-specific quote.

sources.finding: GRARO EU is an actual EU-warehouse frameset listing with variant-specific stock messaging.
sources.limits: Warehouse claim cannot be extended to all ICAN products, sizes, or future inventory.

sources.finding: Provides a manufacturer inquiry route and says an earlier Dutch European partnership expired while a new partner is sought.
sources.limits: Cannot establish that any particular regional reseller is currently authorized.

sources.finding: Published manufacturer warranty includes defect, return, and crash-replacement sections.
sources.limits: The actual seller must identify the terms applicable to the exact invoice; older after-sales text differs in places.

sources.finding: Lists dealers in Europe and North America and links an official online store in site navigation.
sources.limits: Directory and store link do not establish inventory or an exact Spear version.

sources.finding: Official retailer-finding route exists on the current brand site.
sources.limits: Does not verify stock, model identity, or a particular seller's current relationship.

sources.finding: Global directory lists European dealers, including shops in France, Belgium, and Italy.
sources.limits: Does not establish overseas availability of a domestic Super Sport build.

sources.finding: Official order-instructions page exists on the manufacturer store.
sources.limits: Final configuration and package contents require written order confirmation.

sources.finding: Current VB-R-268 listing is the exact product route used in the guide.
sources.limits: Listing photo is not the option-specific contents of a particular order.

sources.finding: Manufacturer product page identifies the customizable R20 gravel frame.
sources.limits: Does not provide a delivered configuration or price for a buyer's destination.

sources.finding: Explains VAT, possible duty, and handling for non-EU online purchases and distinguishes goods already in the EU at sale.
sources.limits: Cannot determine a bicycle's particular classification or final national charges.

sources.finding: EU measure concerns anti-dumping duty on specified China-origin bicycles and maintains extension to certain bicycle parts.
sources.limits: No rate was applied to an unspecified frame or bicycle in the guide.

sources.finding: UK guidance distinguishes VAT, duty, and carrier collection on imports.
sources.limits: Destination-specific treatment still needs an actual quote; Northern Ireland is not generalized from Great Britain.

sources.finding: CBP states that duty-free de minimis treatment for otherwise eligible shipments valued at or below USD 800 was suspended August 29, 2025.
sources.limits: Does not provide one universal duty rate for a bike, frame, or wheelset.

sources.finding: CBSA explains assessment of mail/courier import duty and taxes; current page notes September 2026 measures on certain US goods.
sources.limits: Actual origin and classification matter; the guide makes no rate claim for a China-made frame routed through the US.

sources.finding: 2026 tariff chapter lists bicycles and components in separate entries.
sources.limits: Does not settle classification, preference or surtax for an unspecified buyer's shipment.
